title: Looking for Something That May Not Exist
goal: Describe something you are looking for but have not found, using que + subjunctive.
grammar: Relative clauses with an unknown antecedent + subjunctive

items: I can describe something I am looking for but have not found, using que + subjunctive.
I can tell a real thing (indicative) from a wished-for one (subjunctive).
I can say that nobody fits a description.
